addresses.description: A2=A1=A0=GND (power-up default when all address pins are low)

register_map.notes: Pointer register selects Temp, Conf, Thyst, or Tos; pointer byte is included in bus command, but the pointer register is not directly accessible to the user.

read_channels.read_call_hint: Read Temp register via pointer 0x00; only 11 significant bits are used from the 16-bit transfer.
read_channels.notes: Temperature register contains 11-bit two's-complement data with 0.125 °C resolution.

access_model.notes: A pointer byte selects the target register; a read of Temp may omit the pointer after it has been preset, but a write must always include the pointer byte.

preconditions: Device is powered up and in default state.

steps.notes: Temperature reading data is not available until the first conversion is completed in about 100 ms.

operation_flows.notes: Power-up defaults place the device in normal mode with OS comparator mode, Tos = 80 °C, Thyst = 75 °C, OS active LOW, and pointer value = 0.

preconditions: Temp register selected by pointer or by power-up default pointer value 0.

transaction.notes: Pointer byte selects Temp register; read 2 bytes.

steps.notes: Read the temperature register as MS byte followed by LS byte.
Use only the 11 significant bits; ignore the 5 LSB bits of the LS byte.

outputs.notes: Raw temperature comes from the two-byte Temp register transfer.

operation_flows.notes: Reading temperature does not affect the conversion in progress.

raw_encoding.notes: Temp register: 16 bits are transferred, but only the 11 MSBs are significant; the 5 LSBs of the LS byte are unused and ignored.

registers_or_commands.name: Temp
registers_or_commands.description: Temperature Register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes.

registers_or_commands.name: Conf
registers_or_commands.description: Configuration Register. Contains a single 8-bit data byte.

registers_or_commands.name: Thyst
registers_or_commands.description: Hysteresis Register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes.

registers_or_commands.name: Tos
registers_or_commands.description: Over-temp Shutdown threshold Register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes.

bitfields.name: B4-B3
bitfields.description: OS Fault queue programming. 00, 01, 10, 11 correspond to fault queue values 1, 2, 4, 6 respectively.

bitfields.name: B2
bitfields.description: OS polarity selection. 1 = OS active HIGH, 0 = OS active LOW (default).

bitfields.name: B1
bitfields.description: OS operation mode selection. 1 = OS interrupt, 0 = OS comparator (default).

bitfields.name: B0
bitfields.description: Device operation mode selection. 1 = Shut-down, 0 = Normal (default).

bitfields.name: D10-D0
bitfields.description: 11-bit two's complement temperature data; 5 LSB bits of the LS byte are not used.

bitfields.name: D8-D0
bitfields.description: 9-bit two's complement overtemp shutdown threshold; 7 LSB bits of the LS byte are not used.

bitfields.name: D8-D0
bitfields.description: 9-bit two's complement hysteresis threshold; 7 LSB bits of the LS byte are not used.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up default selects Temp register and normal mode; no explicit bus traffic required.
Wait about 100 ms after power-up before expecting the first valid temperature reading.

transaction.notes: Pointer byte 0x00 selects the Temp register.

read_sequence.notes: Set pointer to Temp, then read the 2-byte temperature register.
Combine MS and LS bytes into a signed 11-bit temperature value and ignore the 5 LSB padding bits.

timing_constraints.name: temperature_conversion_period
timing_constraints.notes: In normal operation mode, the temp-to-digital conversion is executed every 100 ms.

timing_constraints.name: first_valid_temperature_wait
timing_constraints.notes: The temp reading data is not available until the first conversion is completed in about 100 ms.

timing_constraints.name: i2c_clock_period_min
timing_constraints.notes: tCLK SCL clock period See timing diagram (Figure 4) 2.5 – – µs

conversion_formulae.name: temperature_from_temp_raw
conversion_formulae.formula: Temp (milli_degC) = signed_11_bit_raw * 125; one count equals 0.125 °C = 125 milli-degC.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.description: 16-bit Temp register value; use bits D10..D0 after shifting right by 5.

error_conditions.detection: If the configured 7-bit address does not acknowledge during the address phase.
error_conditions.notes: Device did not respond on the selected address.

error_conditions.detection: If the device NACKs a data byte during register pointer write or read transfer.
error_conditions.notes: Treat unexpected NACK as a communication fault.

power_states.name: normal
power_states.description: Default operating mode; temperature conversion runs every 100 ms and the device monitors temperature.
power_states.notes: Interface remains active in normal mode.

power_states.name: shutdown
power_states.description: Conversion stops, supply current is minimized, and the I2C interface remains active for register write/read operations.
power_states.notes: In shutdown mode, the OS output behavior depends on comparator/interrupt mode as described in the datasheet.
